reviewNotes: Reviewed every exported key against all seven cards in data/pages75.json and their vocabulary/furigana. Verified 卵白 らんぱく, 卵黄 らんおう, 気室 きしつ, 卵殻 らんかく, 卵膜 らんまく, 卵黄膜 らんおうまく and カラザ からざ. Converted オレンジ/カラザ to hiragana. All questions and full explanations use Nova generation speed 1.0, including short recurring questions; individual vocabulary and short vocabulary-choice groups use 0.85. Display text and lookup keys unchanged. No listening or audible pitch-accent verification performed.
